title: Rabin-Karp Search
description: Write a Zig program that implements the Rabin-Karp string searching algorithm using rolling hash.
hints: Rabin-Karp uses a rolling hash to compare substrings in O(1) time
The hash is computed as a base-d number modulo q (a prime)
When hashes match, verify with a character-by-character comparison
`+%= q` ensures the rolling hash stays non-negative
